workarounds.symptom: /help_docs source links contain backslashes when PR-Agent runs on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(help_docs): use forward slashes in doc source links on Windows. Target files: pr_agent/commands/pr_help_docs.py, tests/unittest/test_pr_help_docs_doc_paths.py. On Windows, `map_documentation_files_to_contents` keyed each doc as `\docs\guide.md`: it cut the clone path off the full path and kept the native separator. That key is the file name the model sees and returns in `relevant_sections`, so `/help_docs` answers linked to `https://github.com/org/repo/blob/main/\docs\guide.md`. (Ref: https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/4930)

workarounds.symptom: fix(review-context): build timeout is swallowed during grammar loading
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(review-context): don't swallow the build timeout during grammar loading. Target files: scripts/review_context/graph_bundle_ts.py, scripts/review_context/test_hardening.py. `tags_langs()` and the inherited-query loop in `Tags.__init__` both catch `Exception`, so when the `--timeout` alarm fires during grammar loading the `TimeoutError` gets swallowed and the build keeps going. I re-raise `TimeoutError` ahead of both handlers, like the issue suggests, and added `test_grammar_loading_does_not_swallow_the_timeout`, whi... (Ref: https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/4926)

workarounds.symptom: Say that /improve has been merged into /review and will be removed
